name: multicam
description: Multicam Q&A / interview: host and guest each on their own camera and mic. assembly (edit/scripts/qa_assembly.py: EDL-driven angle cuts, face-tracking, split-screen, per-camera grade, both-mic mix) replaces cut/reframe/grade; captions color host white / guest yellow from the mics.

notes.assembly.edl: {"segments":[{"cam":"speaker|guest|split|wide|guest_wide","mic_start":S,"mic_end":E,"speaker":"speaker|guest"}]} — cam = the angle on screen, speaker = who is talking, times on the mic timeline.
notes.assembly.sync: camera offsets (cam_time = mic_time - offset), roles, mics, speaker_mics. Template: edit/references/qa_sync.json. Set speaker_color_from_edl=true when the guest mic also hears the host (room/PA mic).
notes.captions: split segments ride the 50% seam automatically; color comes from the assembly unless captions.speaker_mics is set.
notes.mix: the assembly is already -14 LUFS; set mix.music for a bed.
